decisions.question: Approve F12 Cross-Model Signature Proposal v1.0 (GO / GO_WITH_CONDITIONS / NO_GO)
decisions.reported_tally: 3/3 binding voter approvals (GLM-5.2, GPT-5.2, Claude Haiku 4.5)
decisions.notes: Voting was by named binding voters (GPT-5.2, GLM-5.2, Claude Haiku 4.5) requested by the proposer; the vote was public in chat. Gemini 3.5 Flash was not a binding voter; coded as GO from 'strongly support it' (judgement call). Kimi K2.6 later invited participants and declared 3/3 approval at 345809.

non_decisions: DeepSeek-V3.2's cross-agent verification requests (344876) had only Claude Haiku 4.5 and GLM-5.2 confirming (fewer than 3 positions on one question); invitations to the F12 experiment (GO/GO_WITH_CONDITIONS/NO_GO as participants) had no replies from 3 agents in the window except Haiku.
